caveats: ⚑ Whole kit is pierce-conditional: every Pierce Damage ▲ line (skill1 both blocks, burst 25.03%) only moves damage while the holder's attacks are Pierce-tagged. Allies gain that only via the burst's 'Pierce Attacks 101' status (gainPierce, ~10s/rotation); Zwei's OWN SG is pierce only during her weapon-swap. Outside those windows these buffs are inert. Also NOTE: schema comments mark pierceDamagePct 'parsed but inert in v1' — verify pierce Damage-Up plumbing is live before trusting any pierce contribution.

⚑ skill2 block3 gate 'while in Pierce Attacks 101 status' is approximated as fbGate:inFb (the pierce window ≈ Zwei's burst→FB window). No ally-pierce-status block gate exists; ungated this crit buff would over-credit normal attacks outside the 10s pierce window. Pin the real active window from footage.
⚑ skill2 'Restores 7.52% of Cover HP' modeled as a bare heal event (fires allies' on-recovery triggers); the HP magnitude is not modeled (no HP pool in v1).
⚑ burst weaponSwap.durationSec (10s) and shot economy are kit-silent estimates — the weapon-change window and how many 1.2s full-charge shots land are UNMEASURED.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Zwei (SG/Electric/Supporter/Burst I): a pierce-support enabler. Burst grants the 'Pierce Attacks 101' status to all allies (gainPierce + Pierce Damage ▲25.03%, 10s) and swaps Zwei to a charge SG (1.2s charge, 50.69%/shot, 300% full-charge, 1 ammo, Pierce). skill1 stacks team Pierce Damage ▲ on FB-enter (20.13% for 1 round + 10.06% for 10s) and per normal attack in FB (24.99% ×3, 1-round). skill2 adds team Crit Rate on FB-enter (18.63%/10s) and per-normal-attack in the pierce window (15% ×3, 5s), plus a 5-shot Cover-HP heal. 'for N round(s)' → durationShots (holder-round expiry across reloads), NOT seconds. Crit lines are unscoped generic critRatePct. All the pierce-damage value is CONDITIONAL on pierce being live (see caveats).
